Health Ministry Proposes Relaxations for Medicinal Gases, Drugs

India's Health Ministry has proposed regulatory relaxations for three categories of drugs: medicinal gases, gelatin capsules, and disinfectant fluids. The proposed changes include a separate wholesaler license and a 12-month window for compliance with new bulk drug rules.
